notes: Use AT HOP or contactless. Ferries are run by Fullers (Waiheke and Rangitoto need separate tickets). The SkyDrive airport bus takes 45 minutes. For Piha and Hobbiton, hire a car or take a tour (drive on the left).
December to February is summer, at 22-26°C, when Waiheke and the beaches are lively. Pohutukawa trees bloom red in December. Christmas falls in midsummer and hotels fill up.
The NZeTA and IVL tourist levy are paid online. Turkish citizens need a visa (check this). Coffee costs 5-6 NZD, a café meal 25 and a tour 250. Tipping is not expected.
Book Hobbiton online weeks ahead. Photography is banned at Waitomo. Rangitoto has no water or shops. At Piha, rip currents can be deadly, so obey the flags.
Māori culture is best seen in the museum, with a haka. 'Kia ora' is a greeting. Try fish and chips, a flat white and hokey pokey ice cream.
UV levels are very high (thin ozone layer). In summer you can burn in 15 minutes.

transit.name: AT HOP / contactless
transit.why_chosen: Covers buses, trains and ferries (some, such as Devonport and Waiheke, excepted). Contactless bank cards also work.

stops.name: Sky Tower
stops.tips: At 328 m, the tallest tower in the Southern Hemisphere. Glass floor; SkyWalk and SkyJump cost extra. Book online.

stops.name: Auckland Art Gallery
stops.tips: Māori and Pacific art under a kauri timber roof. Free entry (20 NZD for foreign visitors).

stops.name: Albert Park & Üniversite
stops.tips: Victorian park with a floral clock.

stops.name: Depot Eatery Federal Street
stops.tips: Al Brown's oyster and seafood bar, right below the Sky Tower.

stops.name: Viaduct Harbour & Wynyard Quarter
stops.tips: Marina with America's Cup yachts. Visit Silo Park and the Maritime Museum (25 NZD).

backups.name: Auckland Fish Market Wynyard
backups.tips: Fish market food hall: try the fish and chips.

backups.name: New Zealand Maritime Museum
backups.tips: From Polynesian canoes to yachts, plus a boat tour of the harbour.

stops.name: Waiheke Ferry Fullers
stops.tips: 40 minutes from Downtown (return about 60 NZD) across the Hauraki Gulf.

stops.name: Oneroa Beach & Village
stops.tips: Winter beach walk and galleries.

stops.name: Mudbrick Vineyard
stops.tips: Vineyard and restaurant with city views. Try the syrah; book ahead.

stops.name: Cable Bay Vineyards
stops.tips: Neighbouring vineyard with wine and cheese platters on the terrace.

stops.name: Onetangi Beach
stops.tips: Winter beach walk. Stonyridge vineyard (Larose) is an alternative.

backups.name: Man O' War Vineyard
backups.tips: Beachfront vineyard at the far end of the island. Take a taxi or drive.

backups.name: Waiheke EcoZip
backups.tips: Zipline with forest and sea views; an alternative to wine tasting.

stops.name: Mount Eden
stops.tips: 196 m volcanic crater with 360° views of the city and Sky Tower. Best in morning light.

stops.name: Auckland War Memorial Museum
stops.tips: Māori hall (war canoe, marae), haka performance (extra) and volcano gallery, set in the Domain park.

stops.name: Devonport Ferry
stops.tips: 12-minute ferry to a Victorian town.

stops.name: Mount Victoria Devonport
stops.tips: Short climb to views of the city skyline and Rangitoto opposite. Winter guns are in place.

stops.name: Devonport Chocolates & Waterfront
stops.tips: Town main street, chocolate and Cheltenham Beach.

backups.name: Wintergarden Domain
backups.tips: Glasshouses next to the museum. Free.

stops.name: Arataki Visitor Centre
stops.tips: Gateway to the Waitākere forest (45 minutes by car). Māori carvings and views.

stops.name: Kitekite Falls
stops.tips: 40 m waterfall. Easy 1-hour return walk, with a swimming pool at the base.

stops.name: Piha Beach & Lion Rock
stops.tips: Winter waves; beach walk and the rock.

stops.name: Piha Cafe
stops.tips: Beach café with fish and coffee.

stops.name: Karekare Beach
stops.tips: The beach from the film The Piano. Waterfall and empty sands.

backups.name: Muriwai Gannet Colony
backups.tips: Gannet colony (August to March); an alternative to Karekare.

backups.name: Elevation Café Waitakere
backups.tips: Café with views on the Scenic Drive.

stops.name: Hobbiton Movie Set
stops.tips: 2.5 hours to Matamata (tour about 250 NZD from Auckland). 44 hobbit holes, with a beer included at the Green Dragon. Book online weeks ahead.

stops.name: Matamata Lunch
stops.tips: Town café; try a pie.

stops.name: Waitomo Glowworm Caves
stops.tips: Glowworm cave reached by quiet boat. No photography; Ruakuri costs extra.

stops.name: Waitomo Caves Village
stops.tips: Short break before the 3-hour drive back.

backups.name: Ruakuri Cave
backups.tips: Cave with a spiral entrance. Photography allowed; an alternative to Glowworm Caves.

backups.name: Huhu Cafe Waitomo
backups.tips: The best café in the cave town.

stops.name: Rangitoto Island Ferry
stops.tips: 25-minute ferry (Fullers) to a 600-year-old volcanic island.

stops.name: Rangitoto Summit Track
stops.tips: 1-hour climb of 260 m past lava caves and the crater, through the world's largest pohutukawa forest. Bring water, as there are no shops.

stops.name: Rangitoto Wharf Return
stops.tips: Ferries at 12:45 and 15:30 back to the city.

stops.name: Ponsonby Road
stops.tips: Boutiques and cafés, plus the Ponsonby Central food court.

stops.name: Ponsonby Central
stops.tips: Food market: try Bird on a Wire chicken and El Sizzling Chorizo.

backups.name: Tiritiri Matangi Island
backups.tips: Bird sanctuary island (takahe, kokako). Ferries Wednesday to Sunday; an alternative to Rangitoto.

stops.name: Tamaki Drive Walk
stops.tips: Coastal road with views of Okahu Bay and Rangitoto.

stops.name: Mission Bay Beach
stops.tips: City beach with a fountain. Kelly Tarlton's aquarium is nearby.

stops.name: Mission Bay Breakfast
stops.tips: Cafés opposite the beach. Eggs benedict for a farewell.

stops.name: Britomart SkyDrive
stops.tips: SkyDrive airport bus, 45 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Kelly Tarlton's Sea Life
backups.tips: Penguins and a shark tunnel; an alternative to the beach.

backups.name: Giapo Ice Cream
backups.tips: Ice cream as art, on Gore Street.
